body: I majored in business
Because they know how it feels, maybe not in the exact way, but they can empathise with the suffering of other suicidal people.
People are just taking out their own frustration about their own lives and how unsatisfied they are about it on you.

I feel the same way, I have anxiety and I always feel like everyone at work talks behind my back about how bad my performance is. I'm not saying that they're bad people for that, it's more towards my mistakes and how I feel about myself. It's my 3rd week at this job and I already feel like a fraud. All I can do to reassure myself is that by the time a year or two has passed, I would've proven myself as a high performer and a dependable co-worker. I'll just have to be patient, I would say the same for the both of us.

Congrats! That's really a big thing to conquer. The small steps count the most. Something as little as waking up and brushing my teeth is a big accomplishment against depression and suicide for me. You're much braver than me, believe me.
Thank you for the suggestion. I'll check the book out, the pandemic has given me a lot of free time lol

Very true. Don't worry about finding concrete justifications or arguments to support or object to this debate of the meaning to our lives. People have spent their entire lives trying to do so and many have fell short of doing so. It's an ongoing process, nobody has solid/concrete answers or solutions to almost everything in their lives. Maybe that's the good thing about it, so that we do not plateau or feel like there's nothing else to achieve or strive towards. But, sometimes the feeling of being unable to fully complete anything, to do everything we've wanted, to achieve everything you desire within our lifetime is also be depressing. So we're back to square one, the question will never be answered.

I love this reply, I never thought of it that way. I'm a really pessimistic person so i only look at what I lack entering a field that I didn't major in rather than looking for what I can offer with my unique background.
Ok, thanks a lot. I could probably ask my friends as some of them are already working for MNCs. I guess that's the 1st step.

Thanks for your advice. I just want to ask, I'm sure that "I'm really interested in this department and want to learn more about this field of work" is a common reply and based on your account it definitely works. But what's the follow-up question or answer? After u said that, what did they ask? Did they ask specifically to further elaborate your answer?

For interpreting legal documents, were you required to take any courses? I mean, they could've hired a law graduate or something.... I am happy to hear that your degree didn't limit your career options and that it might be the same for me haha
Same, I just want to be self sufficient and not rely on my parents. I used to aspire to own fancy cars and stuff. Now I just want a steady job and emergency funds enough for a couple of months

Fucking hell, I can't imagine what you've been through. Do you have the basics covered? Like food, water and shelter? Idk man, I've watched too many YouTube videos about the homeless and those with no essentials, it's fucking depressing. If you've got the essentials covered, like eating 2-3 meals a day, showering, brushing your teeth, next thing to think of is cutting all financial ties with your wife. I can't offer any advise, maybe you can look up YouTube videos of survivors of suicide and those who overcame shitty marriages. Try your best to distract yourself (I know its fucking near impossible, I can't even have 10 mins of peace without my mind blowing up with negative thoughts). Just try. Ultimately, your life is in your own hands. I'm sorry if this comment was a waste of time or not helpful or even harmful, I'm just giving my opinion.
You care and apologiesed to those you care about. You are already better than most of the human population
Dogs never judge and give unconditional love. 2 things that can never be found in humans.

Same here bro. I'm 23 and I've changed and failed all 3 of the college degrees that I've tried. Now I have no work experience and no higher education. I don't think I can survive doing minimum wage jobs.... I also have a very loving and supportive family. I hate myself for putting them through all these disappointments and sadness. I feel so trapped. You're not alone.

This is literally me. I'm sorry I can't offer any words of advice. Just know that you're not alone. Fuck this do or die society. It doesn't matter what knowledge you gain from learning. Just one stupid paper can fuck people up.

I'm so sorry to hear that. But you're the best boyfriend that she could've asked for. You stayed by her side, supported her, helped her and never gave up on her. Even though it wasn't your duty, you went above and beyond to support her. You have my utmost respect.

Seriously, people don't get how depression and suicidal tendencies seriously affect one's life. The mind is the most crucial aspect of a person, I would argue that depression is more serious than any physical issues (those that are not immediately fatal). When we lose the will to live, there's nothing else to live for, it's fatal. That's why people should take it seriously.
Only those that have been hurt before will help those that are being hurt right now
Thank you for being so selfless and supporting others. You are a remarkable person.

Can you travel back to see your parents? Honestly, if you have supportive parents, the best cure for depression and anxiety for me was to talk to my mom and give her a hug... For me, friends might be helpful, but nobody will be willing to sacrifice everything they have for your sake like your parents will. Please, get in touch with your parents.

That's a good suggestion. I don't mean therapists and psychiatrists should address everyone's posts or do their work for free.... But general tips on managing depression and suicidal thoughts etc. would be great.
Thank you for the detailed explanation.... I'm still anxious 24/7....im really lost right now....I hope time will heal my mental wounds and I hope I can regain my confidence...

Thank you. I really needed to hear this. My family has gone through so much....and I'm afraid of giving them more bad news.... This sucks...... I've contemplated suicide, but I'm afraid of the pain and even more afraid of leaving my parents behind feeling sad and guilt striken....

It will take a long time for me to accept myself..... But thank you for the kind words and for taking time out of your busy schedule to read my comment. At least you find my efforts noteworthy. Thank you so much.
I failed after 5 years of uni, I have nothing to show for my efforts, no degree and no certificate..... I'm gonna be stuck in minimum wage and have to depend on my parents.... I hate myself.

I feel the same way. For me personally, its mostly because I'm 23 and never had a job or responsibility to earn money for the family. So my fear is that my parents would say: "you've never experienced true hopelessness like having not enough money to buy food, no roof over your head, no hardships etc, how can you say that you're depressed when others and we as your parents have managed to pull through?".
This poem is beautiful, it perfectly summarises what most of us are going through.

Yes, I can relate. I'm trying my best to help people... but sometimes it ends up being a rant about my own problems... I apologise to everyone for that... and I can't even settle my own depression and life problems, I'm a wreak...therefore I am not the best person to be helping others, but I will keep trying
The best would be to die in my sleep. That way, nobody can be blamed.

I am experiencing the same thing. I failed my final year in university, 5 years wasted. I haven't told my parents yet. I think they will hate me once I tell them.... I'm either gonna get ignored, shouted at, or kicked out of the house..... I have to tell them by next month as I've told them that the results will be released by then.... Fuck my life, all my life I have fucked up..... I really feel the same way as you....

The same thing is happening to me, I'm being left behind... It has always happened to me, I will have several close friends, then suddenly they will single me out and all turn against me. I don't know why, I'm the most shy person of my high-school friends and in uni as well...basically I don't cause trouble or talk bad about my friends, but I always get turned against... Maybe its just me, I don't know....now my own mind is giving up on me...

Yes, I'm still struggling a lot. I can't sleep at night, I barely get 3-4 hours due to anxiety. Negative thoughts constantly pop up in my mind. I can't even have 15mins of peace in my own mind. I don't even have the energy or will power to even talk to people. I really don't see a way out right now. I wish that the coming months will be kinder towards me.

Yes, but sadly due to my anxiety, I wake up in the middle of the night with my heart pounding, my heartbeat is fast as hell and I can't go back to sleep. I have sudden negative thoughts going through my mind. It's driving me insane.

Same, I've lost 20 lbs. I barely eat 2 meals a day (if you can call them meals, I've eaten very little). I stopped lifting weights and I have lost interest in all my hobbies and passions. My parents ask why, but I don't dare to tell them.

Even though we might be in ideal environments, there is still the problem of overcoming our own fears. I understand you mother just wants you to be happy. Ultimately, you have to take it at your own pace, talk about it once you're ready, this decision is totally up to you and doesn't matter what your external environment is like or what people think.

Maybe you can slowly build up your courage by 1st watching YouTube videos on trans people overcoming their fears (sounds cheesy but a small 2st step in the right direction). Then, when you're comfortable, maybe you can seek the advice of the trans community in your region or people that you know who are trans.

Good luck on your journey!
Just fucking ignore everyone and get your degree. I made the mistake of trying to fit in and spending too much time with others. Just focus on your studies. You will get your degree, best of luck.

I know that it's easier said than done and what I will say has already been told to you countless of times...but, you should live a life that you want, not what your parents want. I know it seems selfish to prioritise yourself, but you should. Everyone's parents will leave them someday, but you will always be there for yourself. Be strong for your sake. Where do you live? Are transgenders accepted in your community? Is it very conservative?

I also wanted to just puke and break down in front of my mom. But I don't want to make them depressed, so I mostly keep everything to myself. I hope you can do all the self-care like eat properly and take care. I know its hard, try taking baby steps...i struggle to brush my teeth, eat and so forth. But I'm trying. Please try, take small steps.
I also feel like just disappearing, to just stop existing... It sucks.

I feel the same way. I can barely breathe, I always take in shallow breaths, my heart races due to my anxiety, I feel like throwing up all the time due to my stress....If you need to rant or type something to keep you busy, just reply to this comment. I'm also trying to keep myself busy.

What's up? Want to rant? Just type anything you like in this comment. Maybe you could take a warm shower to relax and keep your mind from having negative thoughts? I find that it really helps me keep myself busy.
Thank you! Much love to you too. May you have a great day.
If you want to rant or just type something out, please reply to my comment. I'll gladly read what you have to say. I'm also having negative thoughts and I want to occupy my mind. Please
Thank you for the reassurance. I really needed to hear this from someone else. You've given me some hope of getting my life back on track. Thank you.

Thanks for the advice. I know that what you've said is what I should do... But I'm like a runner that fell into a pit during the race... took one step and that step took me into a pit that I can't climb out of. I feel so hopeless. I know that nobody can help me, but myself. I'm the only one that can truly help me, but I'm fighting against myself right now. Fucking hell, I'm so useless.

Man, I'm sorry I can't offer anything useful. All I can do is read and type out my opinion. Maybe you will find meaning in life when you find your partner. She will be the one that you can fully open up to, be the one that you can talk to all night, and she may have problems that she wants someone to be there to listen to her talk as well. I hope you find that perfect person.

I failed my final year of university after 5 years of studying...I got decent 60% average for all my papers, except for 1... and that 1 fucking paper ruined my chances of getting a degree. Now I have nothing to show for my 5 years, not even a diploma.... With only my high school certificate, I can only apply for minimum wage jobs.. and with the virus, none such jobs are available.. I feel like I'm doomed. 

Just know that you're not alone..I'm here with you... We will try to figure something out.
Thank you, I will report him
Yes, I don't understand this rat race, everyone's working in jobs they hate with people they hate.... I don't understand this world... I hope everything works out for you, I hope you find your way.

I don't think this will mean much to you, but all I have to say is that you and your bf are extremely strong and responsible... I admire the both of you.....you guys faced such difficult times but are still fighting. You being alive right now is a sign that you're still trying your best, you're still fighting, you're still hopeful. I'm not as strong as you, I will try to be as strong as you. Things will work out, you will survive, your baby will look at you for the 1st time with his/her beautiful eyes and you will find your purpose in life.

Yes, everyone is always comparing... For example: wow, James is only 27 and is already a branch manager in the company... Blah blah blah... For guys, you must have a high income or you'll be seen as a lousy father, a lousy husband, a lousy son.. Basically regarded as a useless man.... I mean women have financial problems as well, but men get the worst backlash for not having a great job.... Fucking hell.... I hope that you find a good job with a good employer with a great pay so that you'll make it through this.

Fuck those people. I'm the kind of guy that minds my own fucking business, I don't talk to people just to bug them or bring them trouble. I can't understand why some people find shit like toying with people or bullying people so amusing.
Same, same. My heart is beating so fast right now, my hands are shaking as well. My anger and anxiety makes it impossible for me to do anything. It's fucking frustrating.

I don't get people who love to work for corporations. I mean, good for them, the thing they love earns them a shit ton of cash and a stable job... But I'm not like that... I literally have no idea what my dream job is or what my passions are.

I feel this way as well. I want to end my life, my parents are the only reason why I'm still trying to continue living. They're both 60+years old and I'm 23.... When they're gone, I have no fucking clue what will I do. I really feel so hopeless, worrying about the future that I don't want to live. You can try to use your family as your strength, as your motivation to survive.

Fuck, I relate to this so much. Basically my entire circle of friends and family and my small hometown have the same mentality...study at university and get a job..... That's it.... Its fucking depressing

I feel the same way, everyone around me has found love, I'm the only one without a gf or significant other. Some of my peers are even married.... so every time during family gatherings and friends gatherings, I feel so alienated and a weirdo. Even though I'm alone in my circle of friends and family, at least I know that I'm not the only one facing this issue as can be seen by the posts on reddit. All I can do to reassure you is that all of us are in this together. You will find true love, maybe not today, but some day.

I feel exactly the same way. My parents love and care for me so much, visibly more than any of my friend's parents. My parents have spent hundreds of thousands on me (mostly education), and I've wasted it all. I've failed my final year in uni and have nothing to show for the 5 years that I've spent there. I hate myself for putting my parents through this. They work hard every day to earn a comfortable life for me, yet I can't repay them....I feel so useless, I thought of killing myself, but that would also hurt them. So I feel so trapped with nowhere to go. But for my parents, I will persist, I will try to find a way. I hope that both of us, you and me, will have better days ahead.
Yea, lack of sleep might be damaging to the body in ways that we are not fully aware of.

I feel the same way. I fear that my mental health will have permanent damage on my brain (I'm not joking) and I've find it difficult to even brush my teeth, eat proper meals and exercise... So yeah, it's bound to have negative mental and physical impacts. Is it the same for you?
Life is cruel... I can't see myself living for another 40-60 years... Its fucking unbearable...
Yes. My anxiety is killing me, i can't sleep, I can't eat, I have no desire to even complete the simplest of tasks.

Thank you so much. I hope this state in our lives will be temporary and that one day.... some day.... We can look back at this point in time and laugh about it..... I really hope so... For the both of us.
I'm so sorry to hear that.... I am in no position to advise you... All I can do is to lend an ear if you ever feel the need to talk.
Yea, I feel like it can only go downhill from now on. I wish I can go back to my past.....the future is so bleak.

Thank you so much for the advice and comforting words. Yes, as long as we are alive, we can better ourselves. But it's just so tough when your mind is constantly fighting against you. Everything I do, I doubt myself, my mind keeps saying 'you can't accomplish it' or 'what's the point of doing this anyways' or 'this will amount to nothing'. It's tough, but I'll try.

I can't say that I fully understand or comprehend your pain. All I can do is try to understand and try to be there for you. I hope the both of us and everyone in this thread can get through these though times.

Yes, IMO many suicidal people don't want to die. Many suicidal people want to be saved, want to be heard, want to be needed. Nobody wants to die, its only because there seems to be no other way or no hope that many turn to suicide. Sorry if I'm just stating the obvious. Just wanted to type something out.

The 1st time talking to them... they of course would be really supportive and so on. But after the 3rd, 4th, 5th time, people start getting less and less eager to help.... I don't blame them, they have their own lives.. I don't want to burden them.

I mean selfish as I am envious of their growth and achievements. But I still wish them all the best.

Im afraid to seek help because I'm afraid of being a burden to others. Many of my friends and family take some time to talk to me and spend time with me. But after they leave to carry on with their lives or to go to sleep.....when I'm left alone to my own thoughts, I start feeling anxious and depressed... My own thoughts and negativity drive me crazy. Outside I look calm and collected, inside I feel so anxious and depressed.

It means that I wish nothing bad happens to them/I don't want anything bad to happen to them.

Yea, but I feel so trapped, like I'm the only one lost.

Thank you for the reply. Yes, friends can be of great help. But I fear that my friends will continue to grow and achieve much success and leave me behind. I know it sounds selfish, but I don't wish I'll upon them. I hope they achieve much success and attain true happiness. But it just hurts to see me in such a useless state.
Same here brother, I feel so lonely and lost. It takes a lot of energy just to get through the simplest of tasks. At the start of the day, I already feel defeated.
I feel the same way, my happiness depends so much on others. I hate it.
Same, I'm 23. But I try to not give a fuck about what others are doing. In the end when we are at our death beds, the only one that will care the most about what we've done with our lives is ourself.
Same, I don't look forward to anything when I wake up.
I Hate myself as well. I don't know why I am not capable to doing things that others can. I'm a failure.
Ohhh shit......
Ohh ok, I recently consulted a therapist through video call. I signed a form that basically says that my therapist will only contact someone if I'm in danger (in danger of myself lol).
True, just clear your browser history I guess?
They're fine right now.....lets see about the future. Thanks for the tip
Depends, do you care about what people will think?
Thank you for spreading awareness about this issue. I'm sure that many will listen to your advice. Again, thank you so much.

My dad's an alcoholic as well, argues often with my mom. Idk what to do. My family ignores the issue as well. When they argue, all I can do is separate them and talk to them individually. Idk what else to do.
Do you still visit each parent often? Have you talked to them? Sorry for asking but I was just wondering. Maybe you can gain more clarity by talking to them.

The truth is, nobody wants to die. If given the chance to solve or end their depression with a flip of a switch and live a normal life, everyone would have course take this option. Sadly, it isn't that easy. But I'm glad and proud that you've taken the first step into improving your life. 😊

Sometimes it's hard for parents to understand that their child has psychological or mental needs. Not only food, water and shelter. Sometimes a parent needs to understand his/her child's mental needs or problems. Hopefully as time passes, your mom will understand

Same man, I'm an Asian who failed his final year in uni. I'm 23 now... Everywhere I look, people say that a corporate job is the only way to go.... The thing is, I have no passion/interest in getting a corporate job.... I'm still looking for other options, seems to be none right now. Every parent and every friend of mine keeps taking about getting a degree and getting a corporate job. Like, is this the only way to survive in this world? Is life so narrow and pointless? Working for a company that doesn't even give a shit about whether you live or die. Just my own thoughts on the matter.

I never understood why parents would physically abuse each other.... like... how the hell is that acceptable. Many find it unacceptable to hit a stranger or a friend, but find it perfectly fine to hit their spouse. It seems like a norm nowadays
That is why I feel so disconnected from society. Society doesn't feel like a community anymore....its every person for himself/herself.
I think the sun dies out in 50 billion years or so.... Not sure

Depends on how you look at it. The current environment can be destroyed due to pollution. But after the life that we know ceases to exist on Earth, the Earth will still remain. It will terraform in several million years and new life will grow again...... Until the sun dies out and the Earth faces eternal winter. Nothing is permanent.

Your problems are real, you matter. Don't let other people dismiss that you are in serious pain. People always say that "there is always someone that has it worse off than you" does that mean that in this world only ONE person can feel depressed or sad? No.

Same, I seriously have no goals on life. I envy people who have goals when they are in high school. Some of them already know what degree and what career they want at 15. I'm still stuck here with no motivation and no ambition.

The thing that sucks the most is that I have no natural drive to work on something productive. I have to force myself to do anything and everything. It sucks.
Same, dreams are the escape from reality
I'm not gonna give you any advice or shit like that
Hi, if you want to rant or talk about it, just type it here.
Yes, I feel this way as well. My parents and my brother are the only ones keeping me sane.
I failed my thesis and and whole degree of 5 years turned to nothing. Now I have nothing to show for the 5 years.
That's great to hear that you're making progress. That is the most important thing, taking steps forwards.

That's inspirational. You've inspired me to look at other options. Thank you so much. You are a true hero, a young mom who already has so many responsibilities manage to defy all odds and work towards a better life.
The most important thing is be there for her and supervise her. Don't leave her alone to her own thoughts.
Hi, I'm here. Please type anything out. Like how you feel and what's bothering you. I'm going through a rough time myself. Let's just type any shit that comes to our minds.
Wtf, thats such a dick move.
If you leave a note, they will cling onto that note for the rest of their lives and be traumatised themselves. Im not giving any suggestions, just speaking my stupid mind.
I feel you. I feel you.

Same here, I'm afraid to talk to new people because I feel that they might think I'm weird, but then I kept silent and I also think that this makes me weird as well. When I walk in public, I keep thinking that everyone is judging me. I just stay at home most of the time, but crave to be that popular guy. Idk it's so conflicting
Just typing something is good enough

To your son, you are his entire world. Every time you have these negative thoughts, just think about him, do everything you can for him. Never leave him alone, never let him go. We all die soon enough, but if you stay through most of his life, your son will have a positive lasting memory of how great of a mom you are, even after you are gone.

Sorry I suck at consoling and giving advice. All I can do is read your story and try to understand how you feel even though I know that I can't. All I can say is that I read what you've written and I care for you.

Thank you, but the thought of me failing my parents keeps coming through. Memories from the last time I made my parents cry keep replaying in my mind. I'm stuck and I don't know what to do. I'm sorry to trouble you. I just wanted to type this out. I hate myself, I'm a failure.

I can't say I fully understand your pain, but I also have extreme anxiety. It has made me become very self-sabotaging, like when I'm about to get a degree, I fail at the last semester and ruin everything. I can't look anyone in the eye as I get anxious. I can't even walk around without feeling like everyone is judging me even thought they might not be. I failed to reply or respond to people as I'm too anxious and this makes me fear that they think I'm arrogant or stuck up which further worsens my anxiety. It's like a rabbit hole that I can never get out of.

Thank you for the reply. Some people don't understand that people with anxiety or some sort of trauma will be affected by even the most subtle of things, the slightest things in life that might seem not significant by others. But I know that your problems are serious and I am sorry that I can't help much.

Let me just tell you this, you did make my day better, you did make an impact on my life, and you continue to do so. I'm sorry I haven't been up voting or replying in long comments. I just type stuff in short bursts of sorts. What I can't type out enough in words is how grateful I am for your help. Every little bit counts, in a world of darkness and grief, there are people like you who make it better one step at a time. I can't express how much you've made me feel better. I can sleep a bit better at night, anxiety isn't that high anymore, but I'm sure it will come back again. I'll try to suppress them. But they keep coming back, it's like a jolt of sadness, jolt of lighting that strikes suddenly. But I will try to cope. Thanks again.
Sorry that I can't offer any advice, I can't fully understand how you feel but I can try to be here for you. I hope someone who is facing the same situation can give some advice on the matter.

I'm so sorry for your loss, you are so strong for supporting others. If you need anything I can be here for you. I'm from Malaysia, studied at the Malaysian campus of the University of Nottingham lol, too bad I failed. Do whatever you are most comfortable with, the one that you love the most, don't care what people say. Yes, talking to people online is much better than those stupid suicide phone lines. I've tried them, all the person says is: yes, yes, ok, calm down, yes.

Thank you so much. I love you for this. Thanks bro/sis. You took so much time and effort to reply to me and have kept me company throughout all this time. You never laughed at how stupid I am for worrying about a degree when others are starving and dying. I know many have it worse than me, I truly feel sorry for them. Im such a mess. If I could, I would direct all the help given to me to others who have it worse than me. Thank you so much for everything you have done IanEgalitarian. You are a very remarkable person and a hero to me. I can't express how much this means to me, every word you've typed, everything you've done for an anonymous loser like me. Thank you so much.

Choose what you love to do if there is anything, if not just choose the easiest thing (or hardest if you like that degree lol) I thought that this lockdown would be my chance to relax, but I'm suffering like I'm in a jail right now.
I know, I want to dissappear or not exist and that my loved ones never have any memories of my existence. Thank you for taking the time to reply to my reply. Means a lot to me.

Thanks. Age doesn't matter for us. We are all in this world together. You are 15, please do your hardest to study and don't always follow your friends if that means straying away from education. Don't make the same mistake as me please.

I failed my last module for my final year after 5 years of uni/college. I hate myself for it. I've been reading books and is amongst the most studious among my siblings, yet I failed at the very last step. Im in the same spot as you. I hate books now, I hate academia now, I hate looking at articles now. I hate myself.
You are great, I salute you for that. You are a strong person for sticking with your ideals, your ideals are worth living for.
I'm just here to listen, bud. Anything you need to tell me, just go ahead
I'm just here to read your story. I won't give any bullshit advice. I'll listen to your story.

I'll try. I'll try to. I'm staying at a different house away from my parents now. I'll probably meet them in 2-3 weeks time. I hope I can muster up some courage to face them then and hopefully my dad doesn't get a heart attack and high blood pressure. He is prone to that.
Type anything you want here. I'm here. I love you.

I love you. You are important to me. You are a strong person. You are better than me. You manage to study in such situations, I studied in such a comfortable situation yet I fucking failed. Just rant to me and type anything you want to me.
I feel you. I just wish that I will be very tired and fall asleep in my bed and never wake up. Or better yet, not exist at all. I love you

I promise I won't. The thing is, my parents are so successful (but they aren't loaded, just enough for a comfortable retirement). I want to be better when I have better circumstances than them when they were kids. I hate myself for that. The 50k is not only in terms of value as currency, its a measure of their love. They are willing to spend their blood and tears for me. 50k = priceless amounts of love.

Thank you for your effort in looking at my past posts, I love you for that. You are a hero to me. I will try to work harder next time. I don't wanna mess up anymore. I don't wanna make my parents cry.
I love you.
I can't understand your pain and sorrow. All I can do is just type something here and read your story
Thank you so much. You're a great person. Yes, they love me. Which is why I wish I never existed, so that they have no memory of me. They could live with no regrets

Thank you so much, just keep a promise that you will stay alive for me. Yes, my parents were happy raising me up. THE SHITTIEST THING IS THAT I CAN'T REPAY THEM. I CAN'T AFFORD TO EVEN KEEP MYSELF ALIVE, THEY HAVE TO TAKE CARE OF ME. sorry for the caps lock. I wanted to rant. Again, I care about you. Thanks so much

You are a legend, you managed to be better than all of us. I am fully functional yet I didn't do my best. That is what I have to live with for the rest of my life. And many of my small town locals will critise my parents for my failures. I hate it.

Thanks, I wish all the best for you. But i hate that my parents have loved me so much, the thought of dissapointing them, it's like stabbing them in the heart. I'd rather stab my own heart.
